checks.detail: the gesture staged on a rebuilt bar and the pointer is real; the shipped decision takes a genuine flick at 1.18 px/ms (true), refuses a brisk drag at 0.5 (false), refuses a tap that travelled nowhere (false) and refuses a finger that rested before lifting (false), against a 0.8 px/ms threshold.
